## What's new

Threadnote 5.3.3 keeps deferred code-anchor refreshes focused on the structural graph work needed to finalize citations.

### More focused code-anchor refreshes

Refreshing deferred code anchors now avoids starting background embedding work or historical prewarming solely for an anchor refresh. Normal indexing continues to use its existing background vector behavior.

### Maintenance

Threadnote now uses Effect 4.1.2 internally.
